performance.verdict: Organic-only client; paid is absent, GBP and search now both declining.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads across all 28 days — no paid efficiency to evaluate; entire account runs on organic only.
GBP actions dropped 54.55% (7d vs prior 7d); last 3 days (Sep 10–12) show 0, 0, 0 actions vs prior 3 (Sep 7–9) averaging 1 — sustained zero, not noise.
Search clicks fell 35.71% (7d vs prior 7d); last 3 days (Sep 10–12) total 5 clicks vs prior 3 (Sep 7–9) total 6 — mild but consistent with a broader visibility contraction.
GA4 sessions dropped 49.23% (7d vs prior 7d); last 3 days average 5.0 sessions vs prior 3 average 5.3 — steady low traffic, no Sep 1 spike (28-session outlier) repeating.
GBP call rate is 0.006 per impression — 2 calls from 336 impressions over 24 days — suggesting profile content or category may underconvert visitors who do find it.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP actions daily; if 3-day total stays at 0 by Sep 16, escalate profile review to Sohib.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on each of the last 3 days (Sep 10–12) after averaging ~1/day earlier in the window, and are down 54.55% vs the prior 7-day period. No paid activity is running to buffer this organic drop. If the 3-day total remains at 0 by Sep 16, flag for a profile audit (category, photos, Q&A, review recency). Success check: any day with 1+ GBP action by Sep 16 means the streak broke and organic recovery is underway.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions and search clicks through Sep 16; sustained sub-5 sessions/day confirms site or GBP visibility issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions are down 49.23% and search clicks down 35.71% over the last 7 days versus the prior 7, with the last 3-day averages (5.0 sessions, ~1.7 clicks/day) near series lows. This aligns with the GBP visibility decline and may indicate a local SEO or profile issue rather than a paid ads problem. Re-check on Sep 16 — if daily sessions stay below 5 for a third consecutive 3-day window, recommend an organic/GBP intervention to Sohib.
